scripts.build: npm run clean && node esbuild.mjs && npm run build:schema && npm run build:resources
scripts.update-translations: npm run create:translations && npm run merge:translations && npm run build:translations
scripts.build:package: npm run clean:package; npm run build && cd ./dist && zip -x 'schemas/gschemas.compiled' -qr ../tilingshell@ferrarodomenico.com.zip *
scripts.dev:wayland: npm run build && npm run install:extension && npm run wayland-session
scripts.build:translations: for file in $(ls translations/*.po); do mkdir -p resources/locale/$(basename $file .po)/LC_MESSAGES; msgfmt -c $file -o resources/locale/$(basename $file .po)/LC_MESSAGES/tilingshell.mo; done
scripts.merge:translations: for file in translations/*.po; do msgattrib --no-fuzzy --output-file=$file $file && msgmerge --update --no-fuzzy-matching --previous -N $file translations/tilingshell@ferrarodomenico.com.pot --backup=none; done
